RecoveryProfile.title: RecoveryProfile
RecoveryProfile.description: Stores authenticated user hybrid password recovery metadata linked to a Turkish phone number and Google account.

userId.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the account owner.

phoneNumber.description: Normalized 10-digit Turkish phone number associated with the MariaDB account.

email.description: Verified Google account email address used for hybrid password recovery.

securityQuestion.description: Selected security question for hybrid password recovery.

recoveryCodeHint.description: Masked hint for the user's backup recovery code.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/recovery_profiles/{userId}.description: Per-user hybrid recovery profile document keyed by the authenticated Firebase UID.
